name: CIS Controls
description: CIS Controls v8.1 is a prioritized set of actions that collectively form a defense-in-depth set of best practices to mitigate the most common attacks against systems and networks. Version 8.1 includes 18 controls with 153 safeguards across three implementation groups.

domains.name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
domains.description: Actively manage all enterprise assets connected to the infrastructure

domains.name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
domains.description: Actively manage all software on the network

domains.name: Data Protection
domains.description: Develop processes and controls to identify, classify, and protect sensitive data

domains.name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Account Management
domains.description: Use processes and tools to assign and manage authorization to credentials

domains.name: Access Control Management
domains.description: Use processes and tools to create, assign, manage access rights

domains.name: Continuous Vulnerability Management
domains.description: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities

domains.name: Audit Log Management
domains.description: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs

domains.name: Email and Web Browser Protections
domains.description: Improve protections and detections of email and web vector threats

domains.name: Malware Defenses
domains.description: Prevent or control installation and execution of malicious applications

domains.name: Data Recovery
domains.description: Establish and maintain data recovery practices

domains.name: Network Infrastructure Management
domains.description: Establish and maintain security of network infrastructure

domains.name: Network Monitoring and Defense
domains.description: Operate processes and tooling to establish network monitoring and defense

domains.name: Security Awareness and Skills Training
domains.description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program

domains.name: Service Provider Management
domains.description: Develop a process to evaluate service providers

domains.name: Application Software Security
domains.description: Manage security lifecycle of in-house and acquired software

domains.name: Incident Response Management
domains.description: Establish a program to develop incident response capability

domains.name: Penetration Testing
domains.description: Test effectiveness and resiliency through penetration testing

metadata.notes: IG1 = Essential Cyber Hygiene, IG2 = Foundational, IG3 = Organizational
